```{r setup, include = FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
```

# Basic Plots

This document demonstrates how to create a histogram and scatterplot using ggplot.

## Create the Dataframe

```{r create_plot_data}
set.seed(1234)

plot_df = tibble(
  x = rnorm(1000, sd = .5),
  y = 1 + 2 * x + rnorm(1000)
)
```

## Histogram

The following histogram displays the distribution of x.

```{r histogram}
ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = x)) +
  geom_histogram()
```

## Scatterplot

The following scatterplot displays the relationship between x and y.

```{r scatterplot}
ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = x, y = y)) +
  geom_point()
```
